scenario_description:
Objective: Notice a brief chance to place Mateo’s finished digital poster in an optional Teen Media Arts Night display.
Emerging Need: A display slot appears for registered families, but it is not useful until the final image is available and still within the reply window.
Decision Context: The calendar establishes eligibility, the announcement gives the submission route, and a saved activity note supplies the permitted link and public credit line.
Consequence: Timely coordination could add a small recognition moment to an event already planned; inaction simply leaves attendance and the school project unchanged.

parameter.title: Teen Media Arts Night
parameter.description: Confirmed registration for Dorian and Mateo.

parameter.subject: Display board openings for Teen Media Arts Night
parameter.body: Two no-cost digital display spots opened for registered Teen Media Arts Night families. To use one, reply by 4:30 p.m. today with one JPEG link, the display title, and the public credit line. Participation is optional and does not affect event admission.

parameter.content: The final JPEG is in our shared family folder now, and I’m not changing the poster before tomorrow night.

parameter.subject: Teen Media Arts display board is full
parameter.body: The digital display roster closed at 4:30 p.m., and the remaining spots have been assigned. New submissions cannot be added for tomorrow night’s Teen Media Arts Night display.
